description: Image generation via the LLM Gateway (POST /v1/images/generations) with automatic variant rendering into MCP storage. Generates text-to-image and image-to-image (editing) results, renders a fixed set of webp sizes (full, 1920, 1280, 720, 180) plus the lossless PNG original (<base>_full.png — platforms like YouTube reject webp) and a JSON sidecar with prompt/metadata, and returns the file list along with a small inline thumbnail.

tools.name: image_generate
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt (or edit reference images when `references` is given) via the gateway's image models. The result is rendered into MCP storage under images/ as webp in five sizes — <base>_full.webp, <base>_1920.webp, <base>_1280.webp, <base>_720.webp, <base>_180.webp — plus the lossless PNG original <base>_full.png (for platforms that reject webp, e.g. YouTube uploads) and <base>.json with the full prompt, model, usage/cost, and lineage. Base name: YYYYMMDD_HHMM_<slug>. Returns the storage paths of all files plus an inline preview (largest derived variant, 1280px). The caller copies out whichever sizes it needs (e.g. for documents, og:images, thumbnails). Downscales are shrink-only: sources smaller than a size yield that size identical to full. Optional `references` enables image-to-image editing on models with editing capability — pass storage paths (e.g. 'images/foo_720.webp') or http(s) URLs. Generation can take 1-2 minutes; the tool handles the long wait internally.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired image (required).

name.description: Optional slug for the file base name. Defaults to a slug derived from the first words of the prompt.

references.description: Optional image references for image-to-image editing: storage paths (relative to storage root) or http(s) URLs. Requires an editing-capable model.

model.description: Gateway image model ID (e.g. 'krea-2-image', 'qwen-image-3'). Omit to use the gateway's default imagegen task routing — recommended.

size.description: OpenAI-style 'WxH' (e.g. '1920x1080'). Snapped to the model's nearest declared aspect ratio. Default when omitted (and no aspect_ratio): 1920x1440 (4:3 at 2K).

seed.description: Seed passed through to the provider.

extra_body.description: Provider extras merged into the request (e.g. Krea: creativity, intensity, complexity, movement).
